_comment: Ratchet ceiling per locale, from catalogue-audit.ts. A locale's issue count must never exceed its number here -- see catalogue-audit.test.ts. Lower a number (and commit) as a translation batch actually fixes issues; raise one only when Phase 3 adds new keys to en.ts, which every untranslated locale is then 'missing' until its own batch lands. Never raise a number to make a red test pass. Batch raised 2026-09-23 (MegaMenuNav, ~132 keys): merged with an English fallback in every locale, read as untranslated ('wrong-script') until a real translation lands. Batch raised again 2026-09-23 (MoSJE tier 4, 257 keys: income/finance/helpers/agent/assisted/certVerify/learn/impact/financeAdmin/staff/scheme.*): real translations landed for 18 of 21 locales; brx/ks/sd got the same English-fallback treatment as the MegaMenuNav batch above (+257 each) because no real translator was available for Bodo, Kashmiri or Sindhi this pass -- lower their three numbers back down whenever a real translation batch lands for them, same as any other fallback debt here.
